	"timestamp": _e[1],
	"zm-ver": _e[2],
	"access-token": _e[3],
	"zm-token": "",
	"zm-ua": _e[4]
	}
_e[3] || _e.splice(3,1)
et["zm-token"] = java.md5Encode(_e.join(""))
